title: Cap. VIII Arg. 5 Resp.: remnant according to election (Rom. 11:5, 7); reprobates left to their hardness
pass_a_gloss: To all these let it be added, that when some nation, for example of the Jews, has been broken off from the body of the Church on account of unbelief, yet no one of the elect is broken off: for, by the same Apostle as author, a remnant according to the election of grace has been made safe, Rom. 11:5, 7. Finally, that certain ones are not broken off, others from the same nation springing back and perishing, that happens not because these were elected from foresighted faith of theirs, but because faith was given to these elect from the eternal good pleasure of God, and a reservation according to election was made, Rom. 11:5. So also that certain ones are broken off, by means of their unbelief, and perish, that does not argue that God from eternity reprobated them on account of foresighted unbelief; but that these reprobated, left to their own hardness, brought forth unbelief, the genuine offspring of an hardened heart, and through it, broken off from the body of the Church, perished by their own desert.
pass_b_english: Add this: when a nation — say the Jews — is broken off from the Church's body for unbelief, still none of the elect is broken off. By the same Apostle, a remnant according to the election of grace is saved (Rom. 11:5, 7). That some are not broken off while others of the same nation spring back and perish happens not because these were elected from foresighted faith, but because faith was given to these elect from God's eternal good pleasure, and a reservation according to election was made (Rom. 11:5). So too, that some are broken off by their unbelief and perish does not prove God from eternity reprobated them for foresighted unbelief. It proves that these reprobate, left to their hardness, brought forth unbelief — the genuine child of an hardened heart — and through it, broken from the Church's body, perished by their own desert.
source_text: Hisce omnibus accedat, quod cum gens aliqua, puta Judaeorum, ob infidelitatem defracta sit a corpore Ecclesiae, nemo tamen ex electis defringatur: nam, eodem Apostolo autore, reliquiae secundum electionem gratiae salvae factae sunt, Rom. xi. 5, 7. Denique, quod quidam non defringantur, aliis ex eadem gente resilientibus et pereuntibus, id evenit non quia hi electi fuerunt ex praevisa fide sua, sed quia fides data fuit hisce electis ex aeterno Dei beneplacito, et reservatio secundum electionem facta est, Rom. xi. 5. Sic etiam quod quidam defringantur, mediante sua infidelitate, et pereant, id non arguit Deum eos ab aeterno reprobasse propter praevisam infidelitatem; sed quod hi reprobati duritiae suae derelicti infidelitatem, quae cordis obdurati genuinam prolem pepererunt, et per eam a corpore Ecclesiae defracti suo merito perierunt.
